text: For the theory, the authors model each agent at round t by a belief vector over K answer options: it samples a probability vector from a Dirichlet with those parameters and then samples its response from the resulting categorical distribution, so the marginal probability of an answer is its belief weight divided by the total.
title: Agents modelled as Dirichlet-Compound-Multinomial samplers over a finite answer set
